character.face: same Southeast Asian Muslim woman, warm light-medium complexion, brown eyes, natural makeup
character.headwear: same blush-beige hijab, fully wrapped and physically intact in every cut
character.outfit: same cream chunky-knit cardigan, dusty-peach inner top, light beige trousers
character.body_and_hands: same adult body proportions, two anatomically correct hands, no duplicated limbs
character.supporting_roles: one generic mother in dark loungewear holding one baby; never duplicate the primary woman

product.shape: large rectangular cuboid with rounded vertical edges
product.appearance: white and pale-gray thin horizontal stripes, dark-gray piping, two gray fabric handles, double top zipper
product.material: opaque woven fabric with flexible soft walls; never transparent and never a rigid wire-frame box
product.orientation: front panel and handles face camera; zipper follows the true top perimeter

state_by_cut.Cut 5: folded, then opened to an empty cuboid with lid folded backward
state_by_cut.Cut 6: open on the floor while folded clothes are placed inside one item at a time
state_by_cut.Cut 7: filled, lid laid flat, double zipper being closed
state_by_cut.Cut 8: fully closed and upright, both handles visible

environment.location: same warm gray bedroom dressing area
environment.fixed_elements: tall white wardrobe screen-left, pale gray walls, white interior door in background, light wood floor
environment.clothing_pile: starts inside wardrobe, collapses toward center foreground, remains on floor behind and around the demonstrator
environment.camera_axis: portrait-phone viewpoint from front-right of wardrobe, consistent left-to-right screen direction
environment.lighting: soft warm ceiling light with stable direction and exposure

camera.style: realistic handheld vertical UGC phone footage
camera.movement: small forward push, reactive backward step, downward tilt, then tighter product framing and jump-cut packing montage
camera.final_state: stable close product reveal centered in frame

audio.voiceover_handoff: mother says 'What are you doing?' in Cut 4; demonstrator says 'Check this out!' in Cut 5
audio.environment_sound: wardrobe door movement, clothes falling, fabric impacts, bag unfolding, clothing placement, zipper movement, room tone

incoming_state: closed overfilled white wardrobe; supporting mother stands beside it holding one baby; primary demonstrator is hidden behind the packed clothes
outgoing_state: closed striped storage bag stands upright in center foreground; demonstrator releases both hands; wardrobe and clothing pile remain in the same room
boundary_frame_intent: single segment; final clean product hold with no following handoff
